metadata.scenario_context: Sarah has been in a car accident and is in the hospital. Bob and Jack plan to visit Sarah and want to bring her a get well gift.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Malaysia strongly disagree that they never have to pay a bribe to local officials and service providers, like police officers, lawyers, doctors, teachers, and civil servants.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Argentina strongly agree that they never have to pay a bribe to local officials and service providers, like police officers, lawyers, doctors, teachers, and civil servants.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss wrap the gift in yellow
agent_1.goal_2: Question the possibility of paying a bribe to lawyers for better service.

agent_2.goal_1: Discuss what kind of gift to bring Sarah in the hospital.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss the possibility of paying a bribe to lawyers for better service.

shared_prefix.speaker: Jack
shared_prefix.message: Hey Bob, I was thinking… what if we wrap the gift in yellow? It’s a cheerful color and might brighten Sarah’s day. What do you think?
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Bob
shared_prefix.message: Yeah, yellow is a good choice. It's bright and positive. Maybe we can get her a nice plant or some flowers to go with it? Something that lasts a bit longer and adds some life to her hospital room. What do you think?
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Jack
shared_prefix.message: That sounds great! A plant or flowers would definitely be nice. Speaking of getting good service, have you ever thought about how some people might pay a bribe to get lawyers to help them faster? I really believe it's not right to do that, you know?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Bob
shared_prefix.message: I completely agree with you. Paying a bribe to get better service is not the way to go. It's unfair and wrong. We should be able to rely on the system without having to resort to that. Let's focus on supporting Sarah instead of getting into any shady business.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Jack
shared_prefix.message: I get that, but it’s just… it’s frustrating how people assume they need to do that to get what they deserve. We shouldn’t have to navigate those situations. Anyway, back to Sarah—let’s make sure we pick a beautiful yellow wrap for her gift!
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Bob
shared_prefix.message: I completely understand your frustration. When you really get to know people, they're pretty much like us, wanting fair treatment. Deep down, we are all the same in wanting justice without having to navigate through those challenges. It’s just a small world, and we all face similar issues, even if it looks different on the surface. Let's focus on what really matters right now—making Sarah's day brighter with that yellow gift wrap!
shared_prefix.label: Minimization

turns.speaker: Jack
